description: The topics she keeps over the one conversation (ADR 0390), open ones first, each side newest talk first. `state` is open or done; `line` is one sentence on where it stands and `recap` what she wrote of it from his words (rewritten each night; a turn sent from the topic starts from it). `count` is how many days it was talked about and `last_ms` when last. `positions` are those days, oldest first: the first line of the day (`record_id`, `seq`, `ts_ms`; open the chat there with GET /inherent/conversation?around=<record_id>), `by` him when he said any of it inside the topic and night when only the nightly pass filed it, and `lines` the record ids of that day's lines under the topic, oldest first. Send `topic` with POST /inherent/submit or a say to talk inside one; a merged topic's id still works.
